//: AgentKit MCP server — two ways to connect from Claude Desktop. Keep ONE of the entries.
//_local: LOCAL (stdio): runs the server on your machine. Use the Python that has the deps installed (cd AgentKit && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt). The script dir is auto-added to sys.path so the core/services imports resolve. Needs the shared DB + LLM keys for REAL tool output (without POSTGRES_URL the tools raise instead of returning data).
//_remote: REMOTE (hosted SSE): connects to the live deployment via mcp-remote (needs Node/npx). No local Python, DB, or keys required.
